ir2.2: You find the medical ward and discover a closet with untouched first aid kits. Lose 1 reputation. Each character gains a first aid kit (treasure tile) that can be discarded to prevent all damage from one attack.
ir2.5: The monsters are taken by surprise. All enemies in the starting tile start the scenario with %game.condition.muddle%.
ir2.6: All spawned enemies drop money tokens when they are killed.
ir2.8: With explosives you create a bridge across the lava stream. No effect. Otherwise all characters must spend one item.
ir2.9: You set fire to the dead wood. Party achievement: Smoke Signals. A=5, B=4. Read treasure index 35.
ir2.10: You tell the guards about Nalia's plans. No effect.
ir2.13: Wael finds another way. Discard 2 cards each.
ir2.14: Spend Lucky Eye: no effect. Otherwise all start the scenario with 1 damage and %game.condition.poison%.
ir2.15: All characters add %game.action.jump% to all their moves.
ir2.16: You sneak inside unnoticed. All characters start the scenario with %game.condition.strengthen%.
ir2.17: You reach your destination ahead of schedule. During the first round, return your played cards to your hand instead of your discard pile.
ir2.19: The trees provide great cover. A=4, B=4. Read treasure index 35.
ir2.21: Illusionist classes: no effect. Otherwise all characters discard two cards at the start of the scenario.
ir2.23: Each character may donate 10 gold to add two %game.condition.bless% cards to their attack modifier deck. If at least one character does, gain 1 prosperity.
ir2.25: The Skeleton distracts the snakes. No effect (Ring of Skulls remains spent).
ir2.27: Lose 5 gold each. Each character gains %game.condition.bless%. In the first round, the Bandit Guards perform their move twice.
ir2.29: Statistician: A=4, B=5, read treasure index 35, before resolution look at the top 6 cards of your attack modifier deck and return 4 to the top and 2 to the bottom. Otherwise A=4, B=5, read treasure index 35.
ir2.30: Characters may move up to two spawn locations up to two hexes each.
ir2.32: Spawn one Stone Golem on the treasure hex (normal for 2 characters, elite for 3-4). If killed within 1 round, read treasure 03, 12 and 26; within 2 rounds 03 and 12; within 3 rounds 03.
ir2.33: Your aim is way off. All start the scenario with 1 damage and %game.condition.poison%.
ir2.34: You climb over the lava. All start the scenario with 2 damage and %game.condition.wound%.
ir2.35: Each character draws the top A cards of their attack modifier deck. If the sum of the values is smaller than BxC, characters spend an unspent item or suffer 2 damage to draw two more cards and replace one, until the sum is at least BxC.
ir2.36: Creature-commanding classes: no effect. Spend Ring of Skulls: read treasure index 25. Otherwise read treasure index 33.
